discrete: Exact type, shape and values for IDs, masks, row/frame indices, validity, admissions, reasons and other non-floating values
nonfinite: NaN only matches NaN at the same location, and infinity only matches infinity with the same sign

resource_metrics.peak_vram: Report resources.cuda.<device>.allocated_peak_bytes and reserved_peak_bytes for each repeat. These are the benchmark worker's PyTorch allocator peaks, in bytes, reset at recorder entry. The tolerances below apply to saved outputs; historical device-wide NVML peaks use a different measurement scope.

rationale.float16: One ULP near magnitude 1 for normalized values. Geometry budgets stay absolute.
rationale.float32: Final pixel/normalized geometry limits are smaller than 0.011 pixels on the selected videos. Court geometry is checked to 1 mm and rotations to 0.0001 rad. Masks and other decisions must still agree exactly.
rationale.float64: CPU estimation and diagnostics use tighter limits for the same numerical route.
rationale.unitless: Model scores, feature coordinates in model space, camera parameters of mixed units and other dimensionless fields. Use array dtype for arrays and float64 for JSON numbers; inspect any structural or threshold difference even if nearby values meet the continuous tolerance.
